text:
anya: New iteration pushed: consolidated header, 'Org vs Project' scope pill, daily cost velocity line overlaid on area chart, and an 'Export CSV' CTA. Also experimented with patterned fills instead of color-only. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE-ITER2. Need quick accessibility + finance check.

miguel: The cost-velocity overlay looks useful. Concern: overlay can clutter when many projects are selected. Maybe only show velocity when 1-3 projects are in view.

katie: Patterned fills are good for colorblind, but they cause visual noise at small widths. Recommend a preference: patterned fills on hover/legend only, not default. Also confirm all text meets 4.5:1.

zhao: For performance, if velocity is computed as cost per token per day, let's precompute a rolling 7-day and 30-day average server-side. Frontend toggles picks which series to display.

sam: CSV export needs to include a `currency` column (we have multi-currency orgs) and an `exchange_rate` field if the invoice was generated in a currency different from account billing. Also request: include invoice status (`pending`, `paid`, `failed`).

nina: UX nit: the 'Export CSV' CTA sits next to project search; move it to the right so people don't accidentally click while searching. Also add a small confirmation toast after export.

design-bot: Accessibility check: tab order now logical (PASS), patterned fills accessibility (WARN), text contrast (FAIL on some small KPI labels), aria-labels for export (MISSING).

anya: I'll update: move CTA, add toast, change default to solid colors with pattern on hover, and bump KPI label weights. Also add aria-label to export button.

miguel: Quick question for billing: should 'Total spend' include pending invoices? I think yes if checkbox 'Include pending' is checked; otherwise show only billed.

sam: Agreed. Default: exclude pending from 'Total billed' KPI, but show a separate 'Estimated pending' KPI so users know upcoming charges.

zhao: We'll add `include_pending` flag to the API. Note: we should have consistent semantics across KPI endpoints and invoice list.

anya: Ok plan. I'll post updated artboard + a small HTML prototype for the KPI strip tomorrow. Thanks!
